title: Four Rings
note: คลิปวิดีโอเจนมาแล้วจากที่อื่น ไม่ผ่าน gen-video-evolink.mjs — วางไว้ที่ output/four-rings/clips/ ตรงๆ (ชื่อไฟล์ต้นฉบับชัดเจนไม่กำกวม: The hook / RING N.M / THE FINAL CHOICE)

scenes.narration: Four rings have appeared on this table. Each one gives you an impossible power. Superhuman strength. Telepathy. Luck. And immortality. But every power has a price. Which ring would you wear?
scenes.sfx_prompt: low mystical drone, faint metallic ring chime

scenes.narration: Ring One: Titan's Ring. It gives you the strength of a hundred men.
scenes.sfx_prompt: deep golden energy hum, stone cracking faintly

scenes.narration: You can lift cars with one hand. Break concrete with your fists. Nothing can stop you.
scenes.sfx_prompt: metal groaning, concrete shattering, powerful impact thud

scenes.narration: But the ring doesn't make your body stronger. It makes your muscles stronger. Your bones still break.
scenes.sfx_prompt: bone crack, pained breathing, low dread drone

scenes.narration: Ring Two: Mind's Eye. You can hear every thought around you.
scenes.sfx_prompt: violet psychic hum, layered faint whispers

scenes.narration: No one can lie to you anymore. You know what people want. You know what they're afraid of.
scenes.sfx_prompt: overlapping whisper chorus, subtle psychic chime

scenes.narration: At first, it's incredible. Until you realize… you can never turn it off.
scenes.sfx_prompt: chaotic whisper overload, rising dissonant tone

scenes.narration: Ring Three: Fortune's Ring. From the moment you wear it… everything goes your way.
scenes.sfx_prompt: shimmering emerald chime, coins clinking softly

scenes.narration: You win every gamble. You survive every accident. Every impossible opportunity somehow finds you.
scenes.sfx_prompt: slot machine chime, narrowly-missed whoosh, lucky ding

scenes.narration: Then you notice something. Whenever you get lucky… someone else gets unlucky.
scenes.sfx_prompt: unsettling shift in tone, distant crash off-screen

scenes.narration: Ring Four: The Eternal Ring. The greatest gift of all. You will never die.
scenes.sfx_prompt: deep ominous heartbeat pulse, cold black mist hiss

scenes.narration: Decades pass. Your body never ages. A hundred years pass. You still look exactly the same.
scenes.sfx_prompt: slow ticking clock, faint time-lapse whoosh

scenes.narration: Then, after centuries… you finally discover the truth. The ring doesn't make you immortal. It makes the ring immortal. And you're the one keeping it alive.
scenes.sfx_prompt: deep pulsing heartbeat drone, draining energy hum

scenes.narration: Strength that can break anything. A mind that can read everyone. Luck that can change your destiny. Or immortality itself. But remember… every ring takes something from you. So tell me… Which ring would you wear?
scenes.sfx_prompt: layered ominous drone, heavy ticking countdown
